name: hole
description: Hole, Fruit Hole, Slice Rush and Motor Works - single-file Three.js games, packaged for mobile via Capacitor

scripts.add:hole: npx cap add android && node patch-manifest.mjs
scripts.add:fruithole: cross-env APP=fruithole npx cap add android && cross-env APP=fruithole node patch-manifest.mjs
scripts.sync:hole: node build-www.mjs && npx cap sync android && node patch-manifest.mjs
scripts.sync:fruithole: node build-www.mjs && cross-env APP=fruithole npx cap sync android && cross-env APP=fruithole node patch-manifest.mjs
scripts.open:fruithole: cross-env APP=fruithole npx cap open android
scripts.assets:fruithole: cross-env APP=fruithole npx @capacitor/assets generate --assetPath fruithole/assets --androidProject android-fruithole --android
scripts.aab:fruithole: node build-www.mjs && cross-env APP=fruithole npx cap sync android && cross-env APP=fruithole node patch-manifest.mjs && cross-env APP=fruithole node build-aab.mjs
scripts.aab:hole: node build-www.mjs && npx cap sync android && node patch-manifest.mjs && node build-aab.mjs
scripts.apk:fruithole: node build-www.mjs && cross-env APP=fruithole npx cap sync android && cross-env APP=fruithole node patch-manifest.mjs && cross-env APP=fruithole node build-aab.mjs apk
scripts.apk:hole: node build-www.mjs && npx cap sync android && node patch-manifest.mjs && node build-aab.mjs apk
